info.name: BingoCommerce — Caller QR redemption (disposable fixtures)
info.description: Server relay contract: POST {{portal_base_url}}/api/caller/redemptions. Use only the retained isolated fixtures from docs/runbooks/qr-redemption-testing.md. Import the generated private local environment without publishing/syncing it. Caller credentials and usable QR tokens never belong in this collection. Run acceptance scenarios in order; run the final recovery-after-void scenario only after the guarded fixture void-a command.

item.name: Owned-fixture acceptance and recovery — run in order

exec: for (const field of privateNames) { if (!pm.environment.get(field)) { throw new Error('Set private fixture environment variable: ' + field); } }
if (!pm.variables.get('portal_base_url')) { throw new Error('Set the disposable Portal base URL.'); }

const body = { CallerSN: pm.environment.get("caller_sn"), APIKey: pm.environment.get("caller_api_key"), qr: pm.environment.get("qr_a"), player_tablet_id: pm.variables.get("tablet_a"), request_id: pm.collectionVariables.get(requestKey) };
let result; try { result = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { throw new Error('Expected JSON response.'); }

pm.test('Saved request and tablet correlation', function () { pm.expect(result.request_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("first_request_id")); pm.expect(result.player_tablet_id).to.eql(pm.variables.get("tablet_a")); pm.expect(result.state).to.eql('redeemed'); pm.expect(result.recovered).to.eql(false); });
